description: This Java source file defines the 'Note' entity class for a note-taking application. It uses JPA annotations for persistence, representing a database table 'notes' with fields for title, content, optional tags, and timestamps for creation and update. It includes constructors, getters, setters, and lifecycle callbacks for setting timestamps.
